market_context: US equity futures are higher across the board, with S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq-100 futures up roughly 0.6–1.1%, led by tech and AI-linked names as oil and Treasury yields ease slightly from recent highs.[1][2][5][6][13] Volatility remains relatively low and the VIX is subdued, suggesting a constructive, risk-on tone into the open despite lingering macro and geopolitical uncertainties.[1][6][13] The session bias from several outlooks is described as bullish, particularly for Nasdaq and growth/semiconductor sectors.[3][13][15]
